title: Davis takes SAP security training; he and Grusch discuss hidden SCIs vs SAPs

tellings.quote: I went through when I was at Erol space I went through special Access program security training

plain: The scientist Eric W. Davis says that while at the Aerospace Corporation he went through security training for special access programs, or SAPs, the most tightly restricted kind of classified project. He tells Michels he and David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has made public claims about hidden UFO programmes, talked about how secrets can be hidden in SCIs, another category of restricted classified information, rather than in SAPs, which would matter for where such programmes might be concealed.
